## What's Changed

### Optimizations

- Updated the container runtime from Alpine 3.20 to the supported Alpine 3.24 branch.
- Applied current Alpine security package updates during every image build.
- Updated Go cryptography, OAuth, and system dependencies to current compatible releases.

### Bug Fixes

- Removed the previously reported High-severity dependency advisories from the CaddyMGM application binary.
- Removed High-severity OpenSSL package findings from the Alpine runtime layer.
